title: Brik SARIF Extensions v1
description: Overlay schema that constrains the brik-specific extensions injected into SARIF 2.1.0 documents by lib/transverse/findings/. This schema does NOT replace SARIF 2.1.0 validation (use schemas/external/sarif-2.1.0.json for that); it adds typed constraints on brik-only fields and is permissive (additionalProperties allowed) on every block of the SARIF tree it walks through. A consumer that validates a finding pipeline output should run BOTH schemas: first sarif-2.1.0 for structural conformance, then this overlay for brik extension conformance. v1 captures the extensions currently observed (lib/transverse/findings.sh) and codified in the master  fix-classification model.

properties.description: result.properties open block. Brik may inject brikFixClassification (fix-classifier output) and brikToolBlocking (tool-level blocking flag, lint/format specific).

brikFixClassification.description: Fix-classifier verdict for this finding. has_fix = upstream fix available (CVE patched, lint auto-fixable). no_fix = won't-fix or no upstream fix. unknown = not yet classified. Drives the business.findings.failing.{has_fix, no_fix} counters consumed by the business gate model (cf.  SC1).

brikToolBlocking.description: True when the tool itself blocks the build on this finding (e.g. lint/format errors). Absent for stages where every failing finding is tool-blocking by default.

properties.description: suppression.properties open block. Brik annotates each suppression it adds with brikSource so the policy origin is auditable.

brikSource.description: Origin tag of the suppression. 'tool_native' when the upstream scanner emitted the suppression itself. 'policy.org.<allowlist>' when an org policy (brik-policy.yml) matched. 'policy.built-in.<reason>' when a brik built-in policy (e.g. below-severity) suppressed the finding.
